'''Dhael''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Maiden of the Spear]].

==Activities==
Dhael is one of the Maidens with [[Rhuarc]] in [[Cairhien]] near the [[River Erinin]].{{ref/book|3|39}} After [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]] had been abducted by [[Adden]], [[Aviendha]] found [[Luaine]] and Dhael and rescued the women.
